ares-v6-271.subtitle: The Crimson Commander
ares-v6-271.flavour: "The divine fire does not distinguish flesh from steel. Everything burns."

ares-v6-272.subtitle: The Devourer of Prometheus
ares-v6-272.flavour: "From the torment of Prometheus, the flames of war were born."

ares-v6-273.subtitle: The Divine Strategist
ares-v6-273.flavour: "I have already seen every move you are about to make."

ares-v6-274.subtitle: The Eternal Flame of Wisdom
ares-v6-274.flavour: "The flame of war reveals every weakness before the battle begins."

ares-v6-275.subtitle: The Laughing Calamity
ares-v6-275.flavour: "Go on, my soldiers! Die gloriously! I could use a good laugh."

ares-v6-276.subtitle: Wings of the Catastrophe
ares-v6-276.flavour: "Every beat of these wings carries the promise of another beautiful disaster."

ares-v6-277.subtitle: The Mistress of Nightmares
ares-v6-277.flavour: "Your greatest fear is not death. It is what I will show you before it."

ares-v6-278.subtitle: The Armor of Endless Nightmares
ares-v6-278.flavour: "Those who survive her illusions pray never to dream again."

ares-v6-279.subtitle: The Serpent of Disaster
ares-v6-279.flavour: "In the shadow of disaster, even the smallest wound becomes fatal."

ares-v6-280.subtitle: The Constrictor's Embrace
ares-v6-280.flavour: "The serpent does not rush its prey. It simply ensures there is no escape."

ares-v6-281.subtitle: The Headless Executioner
ares-v6-281.flavour: "A warrior without a head has no reason to fear the blade."

ares-v6-282.subtitle: Armor of the Headless Horror
ares-v6-282.flavour: "The executioner never needs to see the face of his victim."

ares-v6-283.subtitle: The Winged Ravager
ares-v6-283.flavour: "The storm does not choose its victims. Neither do I."

ares-v6-284.subtitle: Wings of the Ruined Sky
ares-v6-284.flavour: "The skies themselves tremble before the wings of disaster."

ares-v6-285.subtitle: The Relentless Hunter
ares-v6-285.flavour: "Once the hunt begins, there is nowhere left to run."

ares-v6-286.subtitle: The Hunter's Cruel Embrace
ares-v6-286.flavour: "A single wound is all the hunter needs."

ares-v6-287.subtitle: The Venomous Executioner
ares-v6-287.flavour: "The pain of my venom is merely the beginning."

ares-v6-288.subtitle: The Scorpion-Tailed Horror
ares-v6-288.flavour: "Its sting carries a death no armor can prevent."

ares-v6-289.subtitle: The Divine Flame of Obliteration
ares-v6-289.flavour: "Enyo is not merely the spear of war. She is the destruction that follows it."

ares-v6-290.subtitle: The Last Defense Before Victory
ares-v6-290.flavour: "Even the shield of Ares was forged to bring destruction."

ares-v6-291.subtitle: Born in Promethean Flames
ares-v6-291.flavour: "The crimson fire of Ares leaves nothing but ashes."

ares-v6-292.subtitle: The Flame That Guides the Blade
ares-v6-292.flavour: "We do not strike first. We strike where the enemy is weakest."

ares-v6-293.subtitle: A Life Meant to Be Spent
ares-v6-293.flavour: "Lord Lior promised us glory. He never promised survival."

ares-v6-294.subtitle: The Whisper Before the Scream
ares-v6-294.flavour: "Fear is the wound that never heals."

ares-v6-295.subtitle: The Hunger for Battle
ares-v6-295.flavour: "For a Berserker, a short life is a small price for one glorious battle."

ares-v6-296.subtitle: The Voice of Endless Conflict
ares-v6-296.flavour: "When the herald calls, the world knows that peace has ended."

ares-v6-297.subtitle: The Flame That Judges All
ares-v6-297.flavour: "Mercy is a weakness the crimson flame cannot afford."

ares-v6-298.subtitle: The First Move of Victory
ares-v6-298.flavour: "A single precise strike is worth a thousand reckless charges."

ares-v6-299.subtitle: The Scorching Vanguard
ares-v6-299.flavour: "The battlefield burns long after their footsteps fade."

ares-v6-300.subtitle: The Artist of Suffering
ares-v6-300.flavour: "The finest torment is the one that begins when the battle ends."

ares-v6-301.subtitle: The Joy of Destruction
ares-v6-301.flavour: "Lord Lior laughed as the fortress fell. We laughed even louder."

ares-v6-302.subtitle: Born for the Slaughter
ares-v6-302.flavour: "Victory is measured by the enemies left standing. I intend to leave none."

ares-v6-303.subtitle: The Arena's Last Survivor
ares-v6-303.flavour: "I stopped counting victories when the arena ran out of bodies."

ares-v6-304.subtitle: Shieldbreaker of the War God
ares-v6-304.flavour: "There is no shield forged that can withstand the wrath of Ares."

ares-v6-305.subtitle: No Retreat, No Mercy
ares-v6-305.flavour: "Every thrust brings me closer to victory, even if it brings me closer to death."

ares-v6-306.subtitle: The Rhythm of Carnage
ares-v6-306.flavour: "Each beat is another heartbeat stolen from the enemy."

ares-v6-307.subtitle: Student of the Eternal Warfire
ares-v6-307.flavour: "Master Ofir taught us that every flame has a purpose, and every enemy has a weakness."

ares-v6-308.subtitle: The Blade Beyond Reason
ares-v6-308.flavour: "His sword moves faster than thought, and his rage faster still."

ares-v6-309.subtitle: The Unbroken Spear
ares-v6-309.flavour: "They guard the god of war not because he needs protection, but because he demands absolute loyalty."

ares-v6-310.subtitle: Bound to the Battlefield
ares-v6-310.flavour: "My life was given to Ares long before I drew my first breath."

ares-v6-311.subtitle: Bound by Blood, Forged for War
ares-v6-311.flavour: "My blood belongs to Ares. My enemies shall pay the rest."

ares-v6-312.subtitle: The Spoils of Slaughter
ares-v6-312.flavour: "The dead have no use for what they leave behind."

ares-v6-313.subtitle: A Glorious Death Awaits
ares-v6-313.flavour: "Lord Lior ordered us to die. I intend to make him laugh."

ares-v6-314.subtitle: Armor of the Fallen
ares-v6-314.flavour: "A broken Warplate is still capable of claiming one final life."

ares-v6-315.subtitle: The Face of War
ares-v6-315.flavour: "Behind the iron mask, only the desire for blood remains."

ares-v6-316.subtitle: A Weapon That Never Rests
ares-v6-316.flavour: "The blade remembers every life it has taken."

ares-v6-317.subtitle: The Last Weapon Standing
ares-v6-317.flavour: "Even in death, the warrior's spear seeks one final victim."

ares-v6-319.subtitle: The March of Endless Slaughter
ares-v6-319.flavour: "The drums never stop. Neither does the war."

ares-v6-320.subtitle: The Spear of Crimson Fire
ares-v6-320.flavour: "Before the warrior arrives, the flames have already claimed their prey."

ares-v6-321.subtitle: Bound by Rage
ares-v6-321.flavour: "The chains do not restrain their rage. They feed it."

ares-v6-322.subtitle: The First Wound of War
ares-v6-322.flavour: "Every war begins with a single wound."

ares-v6-323.subtitle: No Time for Fear
ares-v6-323.flavour: "The warriors of Ares do not wait for battle. They bring it."

ares-v6-324.subtitle: Rage Without Limits
ares-v6-324.flavour: "A Berserker's greatest strength is also his final breath."

ares-v6-325.subtitle: The Weak Shall Fall
ares-v6-325.flavour: "Mercy is a luxury reserved for those who survive."

ares-v6-326.subtitle: The Price of Vengeance
ares-v6-326.flavour: "The blood of one warrior shall purchase the death of another."

ares-v6-327.subtitle: Death from Above
ares-v6-327.flavour: "The sky darkened, not with clouds, but with the weapons of war."

ares-v6-328.subtitle: Leave Nothing Standing
ares-v6-328.flavour: "The flames of Ares recognize no boundary between victory and destruction."

ares-v6-330.subtitle: The Fire Within
ares-v6-330.flavour: "Every sacrifice feeds the fire that will consume our enemies."

ares-v6-331.subtitle: War Is the Only Truth
ares-v6-331.flavour: "Peace is a lie told by those too weak to wage war."

ares-v6-332.subtitle: The Throne of Endless Conflict
ares-v6-332.flavour: "Within these walls, every prayer is answered with the sound of clashing steel."

ares-v6-333.subtitle: Where the Earth Itself Burns
ares-v6-333.flavour: "The flames do not follow the army. The army follows the flames."

ares-v6-334.subtitle: Only the Strong Shall Remain
ares-v6-334.flavour: "The crowd does not cheer for victory. It cheers for blood."

ares-v6-335.subtitle: A Thousand Graves, One Battlefield
ares-v6-335.flavour: "There are no victors here. Only those who have not yet fallen."

ares-v6-336.subtitle: Armor of the Crimson Inferno
ares-v6-336.flavour: "The flames of Ethon burn within every plate of crimson steel."

ares-v6-337.subtitle: Armor of Divine Strategy
ares-v6-337.flavour: "A warrior guided by Ofir's wisdom never wastes a single flame."

ares-v6-338.subtitle: Armor of the Laughing Death
ares-v6-338.flavour: "Even their deaths are offered as entertainment to Lord Lior."

ares-v6-339.subtitle: Armor of Silent Terror
ares-v6-339.flavour: "The armor reflects the nightmares of those who dare to face it."

ares-v6-340.subtitle: The Armor of a Thousand Battles
ares-v6-340.flavour: "Every scar is a victory. Every victory demands another battle."

ares-v6-341.subtitle: The Unyielding Flame
ares-v6-341.flavour: "The warriors of Ethon do not retreat. They turn the ground beneath their enemies into ashes."

ares-v6-342.subtitle: The Mind Behind the Blade
ares-v6-342.flavour: "Under Ofir's command, even the smallest soldier can decide the fate of a war."

ares-v6-343.subtitle: The Blade Carried by the Storm
ares-v6-343.flavour: "Lior's laughter is the last sound heard before the storm tears its victims apart."

ares-v6-344.subtitle: The Shadow Within Your Mind
ares-v6-344.flavour: "Lady Lotis taught us that the most terrible battlefield lies within the enemy's own mind."

ares-v6-345.subtitle: The Last Warrior Standing
ares-v6-345.flavour: "When the final battle ends, only the servants of war shall remain."

ares-v6-346.subtitle: The War God's Army Advances
ares-v6-346.flavour: "The earth trembled beneath their footsteps, and the heavens knew that Ares had returned."

ares-v6-347.subtitle: The Commander's Cruel Amusement
ares-v6-347.flavour: "Lior watched his soldiers march toward certain death and smiled. The battle was finally becoming entertaining."

ares-v6-348.subtitle: The Fear That Takes Form
ares-v6-348.flavour: "Lotis opened the gates of their minds and let their deepest nightmares become reality."

ares-v6-349.subtitle: The Wisdom Granted by Ares
ares-v6-349.flavour: "The divine flames do not merely burn. They reveal the path to victory."

ares-v6-350.subtitle: The Flame That Consumes Everything
ares-v6-350.flavour: "Alcmenes raised his Cosmo, and the divine fire of Prometheus swallowed everything in its path."

ares-v6-351.subtitle: The Plague of the War God
ares-v6-351.flavour: "Before the armies arrived, death had already claimed the land."

ares-v6-352.subtitle: When the Heavens Wept Blood
ares-v6-352.flavour: "The sky turned crimson, and the world learned the true meaning of war."

ares-v6-353.subtitle: The Armies of the Apocalypse
ares-v6-353.flavour: "Four armies. Four commanders. One god who desires nothing but endless war."

ares-v6-354.subtitle: The Crimson Flame Claims a Legend
ares-v6-354.flavour: "Even the legendary Phoenix fell before the divine flames of Ethon."

ares-v6-355.subtitle: There Shall Be No Peace
ares-v6-355.flavour: "Ares does not demand victory. He demands destruction."

ares-v6-356.subtitle: The Last Barrier of the Sanctuary
ares-v6-356.flavour: "Even Athena's sacred barrier could not silence the drums of war."

ares-v6-357.subtitle: The Missing Power of Victory
ares-v6-357.flavour: "Without Nike, the goddess of victory stood before a war she could not easily win."

ares-v6-358.subtitle: The Return of the Bloodthirsty God
ares-v6-358.flavour: "The heavens trembled as the god of war opened his eyes, and the age of peace came to an end."

ares-v6-359.subtitle: The World Shall Burn
ares-v6-359.flavour: "Ares did not come to conquer the world. He came to watch it burn."

ares-v6-360.subtitle: War Never Truly Ends
ares-v6-360.flavour: "As long as hatred burns in the hearts of gods and men, the war of Ares shall never end."

artemis-001.subtitle: Moonlight Lullaby
artemis-001.flavour: “Look at the sky… that is the realm you will never reach.”

artemis-v6-361.subtitle: The High Priestess of Artemis
artemis-v6-361.flavour: "To defy the Moon Goddess is to challenge the heavens themselves."

artemis-v6-362.subtitle: Raiment of the High Priestess
artemis-v6-362.flavour: "The moon shelters those who serve its will."

artemis-v6-363.subtitle: The Relentless Huntress
artemis-v6-363.flavour: "No prey escapes the shadow of the moon."

artemis-v6-364.subtitle: Armor of the Moon's Shadow
artemis-v6-364.flavour: "Forged for those who hunt beyond the reach of sunlight."

artemis-v6-365.subtitle: Guardian of the Sacred Moon
artemis-v6-365.flavour: "My life belongs to the goddess. My strength belongs to the forest."

artemis-v6-366.subtitle: Protection of the Ancient Grove
artemis-v6-366.flavour: "Even when shattered, the roots of the ancient world rise again."

artemis-v6-367.subtitle: The Silver Moon's Protector
artemis-v6-367.flavour: "Where my sister stands, I shall never retreat."

artemis-v6-368.subtitle: Silver Protection of the Hunt
artemis-v6-368.flavour: "Beneath the silver moon, every movement becomes a perfect hunt."

artemis-v6-369.subtitle: The Ancient Guardian
artemis-v6-369.flavour: "Before the first sanctuary was built, the wilderness already had its champions."

artemis-v6-370.subtitle: Relic of the Primordial Wild
artemis-v6-370.flavour: "The power of the ancient world cannot be contained by mortal hands."

artemis-v6-371.subtitle: The Mortal Vessel of the Moon Goddess
artemis-v6-371.flavour: "Within a child's fragile heart, an ancient goddess opened her eyes."

artemis-v6-372.subtitle: The Return of the Moon Goddess
artemis-v6-372.flavour: "The moon had never abandoned the world. It had only been waiting."

artemis-v6-373.subtitle: The Primordial Light of the Night
artemis-v6-373.flavour: "Before Artemis drew her first bow, Selene had already illuminated the heavens."

artemis-v6-374.subtitle: The Blessing of the Ancient Moon
artemis-v6-374.flavour: "The oldest light in the heavens awakens strength that time itself cannot diminish."

artemis-v6-375.subtitle: Keeper of the Lunar Sanctuary
artemis-v6-375.flavour: "Her oath was sworn before the first mortal temple touched the earth."

artemis-v6-376.subtitle: Seven Warriors, One Divine Will
artemis-v6-376.flavour: "Seven vows beneath a single moon. Seven arrows guided by one divine will."

artemis-v6-377.subtitle: The Eternal Spring
artemis-v6-377.flavour: "Even beneath the coldest moon, her flowers remember the warmth of life."

artemis-v6-378.subtitle: The Armor of Eternal Spring
artemis-v6-378.flavour: "Its petals never wither, for the goddess of spring refuses to surrender to death."

artemis-v6-379.subtitle: The Weapon of the Celestial Hunt
artemis-v6-379.flavour: "No mortal distance can shield a soul from the judgment of Artemis."

artemis-v6-380.subtitle: The Arrow That Never Misses
artemis-v6-380.flavour: "Once released, the silver arrow follows its prey beyond the reach of fate."

artemis-v6-381.subtitle: The Moon's Chosen Beast
artemis-v6-381.flavour: "Where its hooves touch the earth, the ancient forest awakens."

artemis-v6-382.subtitle: Predator Beneath the Silver Moon
artemis-v6-382.flavour: "One howl summons the pack. One shadow announces the hunt."

artemis-v6-383.subtitle: The Strength of the Wilderness
artemis-v6-383.flavour: "Its strength is measured not by the prey it takes, but by the forests it protects."

artemis-v6-384.subtitle: The Coils of the Forgotten World
artemis-v6-384.flavour: "Beneath the oldest roots, something ancient waits for the world to remember fear."

artemis-v6-385.subtitle: The Eternal Hunter
artemis-v6-385.flavour: "Even the stars fall silent when the greatest hunter begins its pursuit."

artemis-v6-386.subtitle: The First Oath
artemis-v6-386.flavour: "Every hunter begins by listening to the forest."

artemis-v6-387.subtitle: Guardian of the Ancient Woods
artemis-v6-387.flavour: "The oldest trees shelter the strongest warriors."

artemis-v6-388.subtitle: Eyes Beneath the Moon
artemis-v6-388.flavour: "Her arrow reaches its prey before the sound of the bow."

artemis-v6-389.subtitle: Predator of the Sacred Forest
artemis-v6-389.flavour: "The forest rewards those who embrace the hunt."

artemis-v6-390.subtitle: Keeper of Celestial Rites
artemis-v6-390.flavour: "Under Artemis' gaze, even the weakest spirit may blossom."

artemis-v6-391.subtitle: The Unyielding Roots
artemis-v6-391.flavour: "The oldest trees do not fear the storm. They remember when the storm was born."

artemis-v6-392.subtitle: Born Under the Silver Moon
artemis-v6-392.flavour: "Its roar echoes through forests untouched by mankind."

artemis-v6-393.subtitle: The Silent Watcher
artemis-v6-393.flavour: "The first arrow is a warning. The second is a promise."

artemis-v6-394.subtitle: Warrior of the Dark Moon
artemis-v6-394.flavour: "They emerge from the darkness where even moonlight fears to reach."

artemis-v6-395.subtitle: Protector of the Sacred Gates
artemis-v6-395.flavour: "The gates of the Moon Temple have never fallen to mortal hands."

artemis-v6-396.subtitle: Whisper of the Ancient Woods
artemis-v6-396.flavour: "A fallen leaf is never the end of life, but the beginning of another."

artemis-v6-397.subtitle: Daughter of the Eternal Forest
artemis-v6-397.flavour: "Her roots reach the deepest memories of the world."

artemis-v6-398.subtitle: The Moon's Gentle Whisper
artemis-v6-398.flavour: "Even the smallest light can awaken the strength of a thousand stars."

artemis-v6-399.subtitle: Defender of the Sacred Wilderness
artemis-v6-399.flavour: "No tree stands alone. No guardian fights without the forest."

artemis-v6-400.subtitle: The Ancient Power Awakens
artemis-v6-400.flavour: "When the ancient forest rises, mountains tremble beneath its roots."

artemis-v6-401.subtitle: The First Arrow
artemis-v6-401.flavour: "Before the huntress learns to strike, she must learn to listen."

artemis-v6-402.subtitle: The Messenger of the Moon
artemis-v6-402.flavour: "Its silver antlers illuminate paths that no mortal hunter could ever find."

artemis-v6-403.subtitle: The Clever Spirit of the Forest
artemis-v6-403.flavour: "The smallest creatures often know the secrets of the oldest forests."

artemis-v6-404.subtitle: Alpha of the Lunar Pack
artemis-v6-404.flavour: "The pack follows neither the strongest nor the fastest, but the one chosen by the moon."

artemis-v6-405.subtitle: The Forest That Walks
artemis-v6-405.flavour: "When the ancient trees abandon their roots, even the mountains know that war has begun."

artemis-v6-406.subtitle: The Goddess' Chosen Arrow
artemis-v6-406.flavour: "Her arrow carries not merely steel, but the unquestionable will of the goddess."

artemis-v6-407.subtitle: Voice of the Ancient World
artemis-v6-407.flavour: "She does not command the forest. She merely speaks, and the forest answers."

artemis-v6-408.subtitle: Keeper of the Eternal Waters
artemis-v6-408.flavour: "The sacred waters remember every life the forest has ever sheltered."

artemis-v6-409.subtitle: Weapon of the Moon Huntresses
artemis-v6-409.flavour: "Every arrow is a prayer offered to the goddess of the hunt."

artemis-v6-410.subtitle: Arrows for the Endless Hunt
artemis-v6-410.flavour: "A true huntress never counts her arrows. She counts the prey that escaped."

artemis-v6-411.subtitle: The Weapon of the Ancient Hunt
artemis-v6-411.flavour: "Carved from the oldest trees, its point carries the fury of the wilderness."

artemis-v6-412.subtitle: Shelter Beneath the Silver Moon
artemis-v6-412.flavour: "Even the fiercest storm grows silent beneath the moon's embrace."

artemis-v6-413.subtitle: The Hunter's Final Answer
artemis-v6-413.flavour: "A true hunter carries only what the wilderness cannot provide."

artemis-v6-414.subtitle: The Heart of the Lunar Forest
artemis-v6-414.flavour: "Within the moonstone, the rhythm of the ancient world continues to beat."

artemis-v6-415.subtitle: The Unbroken Defense
artemis-v6-415.flavour: "The forest has endured a thousand wars. Its guardians have learned to endure them all."

artemis-v6-416.subtitle: The Living Armor of the Wild
artemis-v6-416.flavour: "It does not merely protect its wearer. It grows alongside their Cosmo."

artemis-v6-417.subtitle: The World Reclaims Its Power
artemis-v6-417.flavour: "The earth awakens, and with it, a power older than the gods."

artemis-v6-418.subtitle: The Wrath of the Ancient Wild
artemis-v6-418.flavour: "When the forest strikes, even the strongest armor cannot silence its fury."

artemis-v6-419.subtitle: The Strength of the Living World
artemis-v6-419.flavour: "The wilderness does not teach mercy. It teaches survival."

artemis-v6-420.subtitle: The Goddess Provides
artemis-v6-420.flavour: "Beneath her silver light, the chosen discover strength where others see only darkness."

artemis-v6-421.subtitle: The Strength Beneath the Earth
artemis-v6-421.flavour: "The smallest seed may one day become a forest that eclipses the heavens."

artemis-v6-422.subtitle: The Strong Devour the Weak
artemis-v6-422.flavour: "In the wilderness, strength is the only law that cannot be broken."

artemis-v6-423.subtitle: The Earth Remembers
artemis-v6-423.flavour: "Beneath every kingdom lies an older world, waiting to rise."

artemis-v6-424.subtitle: Judgment from the Moon
artemis-v6-424.flavour: "The arrow does not choose its victim. The goddess already has."

artemis-v6-425.subtitle: Life Finds a Way
artemis-v6-425.flavour: "What the world takes, the forest eventually returns."

artemis-v6-426.subtitle: The Divine Order of Nature
artemis-v6-426.flavour: "Mankind was never meant to conquer nature. It was meant to live beneath its will."

artemis-v6-427.subtitle: The Sanctuary of the Lunar Goddess
artemis-v6-427.flavour: "Far beyond the reach of mortal eyes, the goddess watches over her chosen warriors."

artemis-v6-428.subtitle: The Heart of the Living World
artemis-v6-428.flavour: "Every root carries the memory of a world that existed before humanity."

artemis-v6-429.subtitle: Where the First Trees Still Stand
artemis-v6-429.flavour: "The oldest trees have witnessed the rise and fall of gods. They remain."

artemis-v6-430.subtitle: The Eternal Chase
artemis-v6-430.flavour: "Within these sacred grounds, every living creature becomes either hunter or prey."

artemis-v6-431.subtitle: Commander of the Silver Hunt
artemis-v6-431.flavour: "Under her command, a thousand arrows fly as one."

artemis-v6-432.subtitle: Vestment of the Silver Commander
artemis-v6-432.flavour: "The moon rewards victory with strength, and strength with eternal glory."

artemis-v6-433.subtitle: The Wilderness Incarnate
artemis-v6-433.flavour: "The forest does not send armies. It sends its strongest children."

artemis-v6-434.subtitle: The Living Bark of the Ancient World
artemis-v6-434.flavour: "Its roots drink from the earth itself, and its strength knows no season."

artemis-v6-435.subtitle: The Huntress Who Never Misses
artemis-v6-435.flavour: "The greatest huntress does not seek her prey. She knows where it will fall."

artemis-v6-436.subtitle: The Armor of Unerring Precision
artemis-v6-436.flavour: "No shadow can conceal what the moon has chosen to reveal."

artemis-v6-437.subtitle: Keeper of the Verdant Path
artemis-v6-437.flavour: "Every path through the sacred forest leads deeper into the goddess' dominion."

artemis-v6-438.subtitle: The Unbroken Lunar Shield
artemis-v6-438.flavour: "Her shield has endured storms that shattered entire kingdoms."

artemis-v6-439.subtitle: The Hunter of Divine Prey
artemis-v6-439.flavour: "Every fallen enemy becomes another step toward the goddess' ultimate victory."

artemis-v6-440.subtitle: The Ancient Moon's Final Sentinel
artemis-v6-440.flavour: "The last guardian does not defend the sacred moon. She is the judgment that follows its rising."

artemis-v6-441.subtitle: The Moon Rises Once More
artemis-v6-441.flavour: "After centuries of silence, the moon finally answered the prayers of her chosen."

artemis-v6-442.subtitle: The Sacred Oath Renewed
artemis-v6-442.flavour: "Seven warriors answered the call. Seven destinies became one."

artemis-v6-443.subtitle: The Hunt Begins
artemis-v6-443.flavour: "The first blood spilled beneath the moon marked the beginning of a war without mercy."

artemis-v6-444.subtitle: The Earth Reclaims the Sacred Ground
artemis-v6-444.flavour: "The stone pillars of Sanctuary cracked as ancient roots rose to reclaim the land."

artemis-v6-445.subtitle: Two Goddesses, One World
artemis-v6-445.flavour: "Athena saw humanity's potential. Artemis saw the destruction it had already caused."

artemis-v6-446.subtitle: The Mortal Vessel Transformed
artemis-v6-446.flavour: "A child's eyes opened, but the soul looking through them belonged to a goddess."

artemis-v6-447.subtitle: The Price of Divine Loyalty
artemis-v6-447.flavour: "They fell beneath the same moon, their vows unbroken even in death."

artemis-v6-448.subtitle: The Goddess Demands Balance
artemis-v6-448.flavour: "The goddess did not see cruelty in her judgment. She saw the restoration of balance."

artemis-v6-450.subtitle: The End of Mankind's Dominion
artemis-v6-450.flavour: "The world did not end. It simply remembered who ruled it before mankind."

neutral-v6-451.subtitle: The Fist of Black Death
neutral-v6-451.flavour: "His fists carry the same stars as Pegasus, but every star has turned black."

neutral-v6-452.subtitle: The Dragon of Darkness
neutral-v6-452.flavour: "His strength rivals the Dragon, but his heart has forgotten the meaning of honor."

neutral-v6-453.subtitle: The Frozen Shadow
neutral-v6-453.flavour: "His ice does not shine like a diamond. It swallows every trace of light."

neutral-v6-454.subtitle: The Chains of Corruption
neutral-v6-454.flavour: "Unlike the chains of Andromeda, these serpents do not protect. They hunger."

neutral-v6-455.subtitle: The False Immortal
neutral-v6-455.flavour: "He imitates the Phoenix's resurrection, but every return consumes another piece of his soul."

neutral-v6-456.subtitle: The Tyrant of Death Queen Island
neutral-v6-456.flavour: "On Death Queen Island, power was the only law, and Jango declared himself its king."

neutral-v6-457.subtitle: The Eyes Within Darkness
neutral-v6-457.flavour: "Though his eyes could see nothing, his senses revealed the movements hidden in darkness."

neutral-v6-458.subtitle: The Imitation of Immortality
neutral-v6-458.flavour: "They wore the shape of the Phoenix, but possessed none of its eternal flame."

neutral-v6-459.subtitle: The Crushing Shadow of the Sea
neutral-v6-459.flavour: "The weight of darkness is greater than the weight of any armor."

neutral-v6-460.subtitle: The Dark Gallop
neutral-v6-460.flavour: "He charges without fear, for darkness has already taken everything he could lose."

neutral-v6-461.subtitle: The Wings of Steel
neutral-v6-461.flavour: "His wings were not born from the stars, but from humanity's determination to reach them."

neutral-v6-462.subtitle: The Unbreakable Earth
neutral-v6-462.flavour: "The ground itself trembles beneath the weight of his steel armor."

neutral-v6-463.subtitle: The Mechanical Ocean
neutral-v6-463.flavour: "His armor transforms the ocean's vibrations into weapons of extraordinary precision."

neutral-v6-464.subtitle: The Genius Behind the Steel Saints
neutral-v6-464.flavour: "Where others sought divine power, he discovered that human ingenuity could challenge the gods."

neutral-v6-465.subtitle: The Mechanical Wings of the Toucan
neutral-v6-465.flavour: "Forged without divine blessings, its wings proved that humanity could challenge the heavens."

neutral-v6-466.subtitle: The Mechanical Armor of the Fox
neutral-v6-466.flavour: "Its strength comes not from ancient legends, but from the earth beneath mankind's feet."

neutral-v6-467.subtitle: The Mechanical Armor of the Swordfish
neutral-v6-467.flavour: "Its mechanical resonance turns the silence of the ocean into a devastating force."

neutral-v6-468.subtitle: A Warrior Without a Constellation
neutral-v6-468.flavour: "Not all heroes are chosen by the stars. Some build their own destiny."

neutral-v6-469.subtitle: The First Step Toward Artificial Cosmo
neutral-v6-469.flavour: "Every masterpiece begins as an experiment, and every experiment carries the risk of failure."

neutral-v6-470.subtitle: Where Humanity Challenges the Gods
neutral-v6-470.flavour: "Within these walls, science became humanity's answer to divine power."

neutral-v6-471.subtitle: The Mistress of Illusions
neutral-v6-471.flavour: "Her greatest weapon was never her strength, but the illusions that made enemies doubt their own senses."

neutral-v6-472.subtitle: The Phantom of the Waves
neutral-v6-472.flavour: "He strikes from beneath the waves and vanishes before his enemies understand what happened."

neutral-v6-473.subtitle: The Venom Beneath the Surface
neutral-v6-473.flavour: "The sea hides countless dangers, but few are as merciless as the serpent beneath its surface."

neutral-v6-474.subtitle: The Living Paralysis
neutral-v6-474.flavour: "His touch carries no visible wound, only the terrifying silence of a body that refuses to move."

neutral-v6-475.subtitle: The Ocean Hides Its Deadliest Warriors
neutral-v6-475.flavour: "The sea reveals its secrets only after the enemy has already disappeared beneath the waves."

neutral-v6-476.subtitle: The Universe Falls Silent
neutral-v6-476.flavour: "Even the greatest technique becomes meaningless when the flow of Cosmo is severed."

neutral-v6-477.subtitle: A Second Chance Bought With Blood
neutral-v6-477.flavour: "To pull a warrior back from death is to surrender a fragment of your own existence."

neutral-v6-478.subtitle: A Fragment of the Infinite Universe
neutral-v6-478.flavour: "Within a fragment of crystal, the endless energy of the universe waits to be awakened."

neutral-v6-479.subtitle: The Secrets Beyond the Seventh Sense
neutral-v6-479.flavour: "Some truths cannot be discovered without sacrificing a part of the soul."

neutral-v6-480.subtitle: No Warrior Stands Above Fate
neutral-v6-480.flavour: "When judgment comes from beyond the stars, even the strongest armor offers no protection."

neutral-v6-481.subtitle: The Master of Eternal Ice
neutral-v6-481.flavour: "Before the Swan learned to fly, he was taught to master the silence of eternal ice."

neutral-v6-482.subtitle: The Tiger of Rozan
neutral-v6-482.flavour: "He possessed the strength of a tiger, but never learned the patience of a dragon."

neutral-v6-483.subtitle: The Rival of Andromeda
neutral-v6-483.flavour: "His chains were forged for battle, but envy became the heaviest chain of all."

neutral-v6-484.subtitle: The Second Chain of Andromeda
neutral-v6-484.flavour: "Two chains, one ambition, and a rivalry neither warrior could overcome."

neutral-v6-485.subtitle: The Dance of a Thousand Feathers
neutral-v6-485.flavour: "His movements were beautiful as a peacock's feathers and deadly as a storm of blades."

neutral-v6-486.subtitle: The Disciple of Enlightenment
neutral-v6-486.flavour: "The lotus rises from the mud, untouched by the darkness from which it grows."

neutral-v6-487.subtitle: The Hunter of the Mountains
neutral-v6-487.flavour: "His web was invisible until his prey discovered that escape was already impossible."

neutral-v6-488.subtitle: The Architect of Betrayal
neutral-v6-488.flavour: "He wielded neither legendary Cloth nor divine power, yet his ambitions threatened the Sanctuary itself."

neutral-v6-489.subtitle: The Hand of the False Pope
neutral-v6-489.flavour: "He followed the Pope's commands without questioning the darkness behind the throne."

neutral-v6-490.subtitle: Strength Without Allegiance
neutral-v6-490.flavour: "Some warriors fight for gods. Others fight for whoever pays the highest price."

neutral-v6-491.subtitle: The Instruments of Restoration
neutral-v6-491.flavour: "Even the strongest armor cannot survive forever without the hands that restore it."

neutral-v6-492.subtitle: The Seal of the Black Saints
neutral-v6-492.flavour: "The mask concealed their faces, but never the darkness consuming their souls."

neutral-v6-493.subtitle: Artificial Energy Regulation
neutral-v6-493.flavour: "Humanity learned to manipulate Cosmo, but every artificial miracle demanded a sacrifice."

neutral-v6-494.subtitle: Resources for the Long War
neutral-v6-494.flavour: "Warriors may survive on courage, but armies survive on preparation."

neutral-v6-495.subtitle: Beyond the Reach of the Stars
neutral-v6-495.flavour: "To remove an enemy from existence is to disturb the balance of the universe itself."

neutral-v6-496.subtitle: Power Taken by Force
neutral-v6-496.flavour: "The universe grants power freely to those who understand it. Those who steal it must pay."

neutral-v6-497.subtitle: Survival Against Impossible Odds
neutral-v6-497.flavour: "Survival is sometimes the greatest victory a warrior can achieve."

neutral-v6-498.subtitle: Where Darkness Forged Its Warriors
neutral-v6-498.flavour: "On Death Queen Island, victory was not earned through honor, but through the destruction of everyone who stood in the way."

neutral-v6-499.subtitle: The Will to Challenge the Gods
neutral-v6-499.flavour: "When gods demanded submission, humanity answered with the courage to stand against them."

neutral-v6-500.subtitle: Awakening Beyond Death
neutral-v6-500.flavour: "Beyond the Seventh Sense lies a power that allows the living to cross the boundary between life and death."
